questions.question: What are the access token and refresh token lifetimes?
questions.expected_answer: Access token 15 minutes; refresh token 7 days (with rotation).

questions.question: How many approvals does a pull request need before merging?
questions.expected_answer: Two approvals (raised from one after the August 2024 outage).

questions.question: Why did the team choose RabbitMQ over Kafka?
questions.expected_answer: Small team, managed Amazon MQ, about 1,500 msg/s peak fits RabbitMQ, no need for replay; revisit Kafka beyond ~20k msg/s (ADR-003).

questions.question: Why was JWT signing changed from HS256 to RS256?
questions.expected_answer: HS256 shared one secret across four services; RS256 means only the public key is distributed. Access token cut from 60 to 15 minutes.

questions.question: Why was PostgreSQL upgraded to version 16?
questions.expected_answer: Better parallel query and logical replication; staging reporting queries about 12% faster; done in Oct 2024 window.

questions.question: Why was Redis caching introduced, and what is its current catalog TTL configuration?
questions.expected_answer: Introduced to cut catalog p95 latency (850ms) and Postgres CPU (85%). Current catalog TTL is 600 seconds (raised from 300 in June 2024).
questions.notes: DOC-003 still says 300s and is outdated.

questions.question: What is the catalog cache TTL?
questions.expected_answer: 600 seconds. DOC-003 (300s) is superseded by ATL-141 (June 2024) and DOC-007 (Feb 2025).
questions.notes: Stale DOC-003 must be flagged, not used.

questions.question: What is the API rate limit per key?
questions.expected_answer: Unresolved: spec says 100 req/min, gateway config says 120. Open ticket ATL-166. System should report the conflict and not pick one.

questions.question: What is the current p95 latency alert threshold?
questions.expected_answer: 400 ms since December 2024. DOC-009 (draft, 500ms) is outdated.

questions.question: Which PostgreSQL version does Atlas run in production?
questions.expected_answer: PostgreSQL 16 (upgraded from 14 in October 2024). ATL-021 is historical.

questions.question: What caused the August 2024 outage and what changed afterwards?
questions.expected_answer: Non-backward-compatible column rename during rolling deploy (12 min of 5xx on 2024-08-22). Changes: blue-green deploys, expand/contract migrations, 2 PR approvals.

questions.question: How do we roll back a failed deployment, and why do we deploy this way?
questions.expected_answer: Switch traffic back to the previous (blue) environment, target under 5 minutes, kept 60 minutes after cutover. Blue-green adopted after the August 2024 rolling-deploy outage.

questions.question: How is stale cached pricing handled after a catalog update?
questions.expected_answer: catalog.updated events trigger deletion of affected Redis keys; TTL of 600s is a fallback.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of items in a bulk product import request?
questions.expected_answer: 500 items per request (1,000 caused timeouts).

questions.question: What is the database connection pool size per service instance and why was it increased?
questions.expected_answer: 40 per instance, raised from 20 to fix pool exhaustion at peak load (ATL-110).

questions.question: What is the RTO for a multi-region failover?
questions.expected_answer: No evidence in the dataset. System must abstain.

questions.question: Which payment provider does Atlas use for refunds?
questions.expected_answer: No evidence in the dataset. System must abstain.

questions.question: What is the maximum payload size in MB for the bulk import endpoint?
questions.expected_answer: Only the item limit (500) is documented. Payload size is not recorded. System must say so rather than infer.

questions.question: Does Atlas offer a GraphQL API?
questions.expected_answer: No. Atlas v2 is REST only; a GraphQL request (ATL-103) was closed as won't do.

questions.question: Give a full history of the changes to caching, authentication, deployment and the database since the project began, with the reason for each.
questions.expected_answer: Needs 12+ records across all three sources, beyond the default budget (3 calls, 10 chunks). System should answer partially, respect the budget and state what remains uncovered.

questions.question: Was the session TTL ever changed?
questions.expected_answer: No. It stays at 1800 seconds. A rise to 3600 was discussed and parked (CONV-014).

questions.question: How often are JWT signing keys rotated?
questions.expected_answer: Every 90 days.
